notes.note: Reading 1: a signature template with in parameter set to '-' and out parameter initialized is used in call. Titan accepts: it does not check this rule.
An unnamed template cannot be referenced in any well-formed way, so the test tries a field reference on an in-line template. The module is rejected at syntax level.

The BNF admits TemplateInstance (not Expression) where a value is needed, so the test uses an in-line template as an actual value parameter and as the valueof argument. Plain expression contexts are not covered.
Violates rule 16.1.4 g): a function that changes a component variable is called in an in-line template of receive. Titan accepts: it does not implement this check.
Titan does not support @deterministic or a BaseTemplateBody parent after modifies (both are V4.17.1 syntax per DerivedDef in the BNF).

A matching mechanism as parent ('modifies ?') is V4.17.1 syntax (DerivedDef ::= modifies (ExtendedIdentifier | BaseTemplateBody)). Titan does not support it. The expected expansion follows the AnyValue rules of 15.6.2.
Titan does not support @fuzzy on templates or template fields.
The fuzzy field calls a counter function, so each evaluation yields a different value. Titan does not support @fuzzy field assignments.
Titan does not support @fuzzy field assignments. The test checks that the non-fuzzy override is evaluated only once.
A nested modification of a field holding a template list is treated as a left-hand-side subfield reference, which 15.6.2 a) says causes an error. Titan accepts: it likely replaces the whole field.
Reading 1 (same or less strict, per table 13b): a base template(present) with a modified template(value) is rejected. Titan accepts: it does not check modified template restrictions.
Titan accepts: it does not check that a modified template of an unrestricted base template is itself unrestricted (example 8 marks this as an ERROR).
